# PlotTrellis example project. Mouse mammary basal cells (Basal) and luminal progenitors (LP)
# from Milevskiy et al. 2023, Cell Genomics (GEO GSE227750), cut down to the Ehf, Elf5 and Cat
# genes on chr2 (mm10). Search for Elf5: almost silent in Basal, highly expressed in LP.
#
# To set up your own project, copy this file and change:
#   data_root      the folder your data files are in (relative to this file, or a full path)
#   gtf_path       your genome's GTF, GENCODE or Ensembl (relative to this file, or a full path)
#   orgdb          your species' OrgDb package, e.g. org.Hs.eg.db for human
#   genome_label   the UCSC name of your genome build, e.g. hg38
#   start_gene, start_tracks   optional: the gene and tracks the app opens on
# then list one row per sample. Each column after colour is type:name, and each cell is a
# path relative to data_root (bw = bigWig, quantdir = a Salmon output folder holding quant.sf).
# data_root: .
# gtf_path: gencode.vM25.example.gtf.gz
# orgdb: org.Mm.eg.db
# genome_label: mm10
# start_gene: Elf5
# start_tracks: atac@Basal, atac@LP, transcript_counts@Basal, transcript_counts@LP, transcripts_annotated, genes
condition	colour	bw:atac	quantdir:Quant
Basal	#b31e1e	atac/Basal_ATAC.bw	quant/Basal_rep1
LP	#4b7538	atac/LP_ATAC.bw	quant/LP_rep1
